name: B10-0190/2024 (Verts/ALE) – The shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Cambodia to stop targeting a labour rights group called CENTRAL. It wants all charges against the group dropped and detained activists released. It also asks the European Union to use its trade and aid power: review tariff benefits, consider sanctions on officials, and give more support to civil society groups. It calls on companies selling goods from Cambodia to check their supply chains for rights abuses. The text is a request, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a formal request to Cambodia, the EU Commission, Council and companies.
- **Who it affects:** Cambodia's government, CENTRAL and activists, EU officials, and companies sourcing from Cambodia.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends the text to the parties involved; they decide whether to act.
